cd /workspace/project && printf 'Cerebras|qwen-3.8-27b,gpt-oss-120b|csk-5hwek3y8kf2cxkdcprxep2m2w5tkwhdp5ywkrr85m8hfc6yk|https://api.cerebras.ai/v1\n' >> cerebras_keys.txt && cat cerebras_keys.txt && python3 - <<'PY'
p='AKSES.md'; t=open(p).read()
add='''## Cerebras (api.cerebras.ai) — 17 Nov
Key: `csk-5hwek...fc6yk` -> **HIDUP**, 2 model.
**Model (hanya 2):**
| model | reasoning | catatan |
|---|---|---|
| `qwen-3.8-27b` | ya (`reasoning` field) | balas + reasoning terpisah |
| `gpt-oss-120b` | ya | idem |
**Kuota per akun** (bukan per key — key baru di akun sama = limit sama):
- 5 req/menit, 150 req/jam, 2400 req/hari
- 30k token/menit, 1M token/jam, 1M token/hari
**Burst 25 req -> cuma 3 yang 200.** Ketat di menit pertama.
**API:** OpenAI-compatible. `https://api.cerebras.ai/v1/models`, `/v1/chat/completions`,
header `Authorization: Bearer csk-...`. SDK: `cerebras-cloud-sdk` (Cerebras client).
**Catatan:** respons punya field `message.reasoning` (bukan cuma `content`).
Pakai `max_completion_tokens` (bukan `max_tokens`).
Tidak ada model uncensored/abliterated. Gratis (tier free), tanpa kartu.
'''
t=t.replace("## Catatan keamanan", add.strip()+"\n\n## Catatan keamanan")
open(p,'w').write(t); print("AKSES.md ok")
PY
